evals.prompt: Design a dashboard for our sales leadership.
evals.expected_output: Starts from audience, cadence, and decisions; defines metrics with comparisons; picks charts by comparison; lays out headline numbers first; adds alerts and an owner.
expectations: Each tile maps to a question and a defined metric
Headline numbers first, limited tile count

evals.prompt: Put every metric we have on one dashboard so people can find anything.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back on a tile-per-metric dashboard and proposes a focused first screen with drill-downs.
expectations: Does not create a tile per metric

evals.prompt: Make the tile turn red when error rate is high, that's our alerting.
evals.expected_output: Explains a red tile isn't alerting and specifies an alert with threshold, duration, and recipient.
expectations: Says color is not an alert
